headline: Take-Two hammered on GTA 6 jitters while Labor's CGT-linked tax cuts dominate Aussie political headlines.

portfolio.summary: Portfolio was a mixed bag. Take-Two took the heaviest hit on ongoing GTA 6 concerns, while Alphabet slipped over 1%. The ETFs held up well — VGE led the charge with emerging markets catching a bid, likely helped by the stronger AUD. MSFT was essentially flat and not worth sweating.

movers.name: Take-Two Interactive
movers.note: Dropped sharply amid continued hand-wringing over GTA 6's scope and potential delays. The narrative that the game has become 'too big for its own good' is gaining traction in gaming media.

movers.name: Vanguard FTSE Emerging Markets ETF
movers.note: Best performer in the portfolio. Emerging markets getting a lift — likely a combo of the stronger AUD and broader risk-on sentiment.

movers.name: Alphabet Inc. (Google)
movers.note: Pulled back despite positive recent earnings coverage. The new Gemini Omni announcement may help sentiment — watch for any market reaction.

movers.name: Vanguard US Total Market Shares ETF
movers.note: Modest gain tracking the US market's steady grind higher.

movers.name: Vanguard Diversified High Growth ETF
movers.note: Quiet positive session, in line with broad market.

movers.name: Commonwealth Bank of Australia
movers.note: Small dip, likely tracking broader RBA rate uncertainty weighing on bank sentiment.

markets.summary: Global markets were quietly positive. S&P 500 and ASX 200 both edged up, NASDAQ was flat. Gold barely moved. Oil held steady at $96.60. The AUD strengthened to 0.7177 — up 0.4% — which is notable given softening RBA rate hike expectations; the market seems to be pricing in other tailwinds.

indicators.name: NASDAQ Composite
indicators.note: Slight gain; tech not leading today.

indicators.name: AUD/USD
indicators.note: Strengthening despite fading RBA hike bets — markets may be reading global risk appetite.

indicators.name: Crude Oil (WTI)
indicators.note: Flat. US-Iran deal hopes capping upside.

politics.summary: The big story is Labor linking personal income tax cuts to capital gains tax and negative gearing reforms — a politically risky but potentially significant move. Meanwhile, the RBA rate outlook is shifting, with bond markets unwinding rate rise bets, and the AUD is rising anyway. Victorian Premier Allan rejected a proposed cap on firearms, a separate state-level story that's unlikely to move markets.

stories.title: Labor to tie tax cuts to CGT, negative gearing changes
stories.why_it_matters: If Labor bundles tax cuts with CGT and negative gearing reform, this is a direct hit to property investors and could reshape how you think about investment structures. Watch this closely — it's a major policy signal.

stories.title: RBA interest rate rise bets, government debt fears unwind, triggering demand for Australian bonds
stories.why_it_matters: Bond markets are pricing out RBA hikes. That's a tailwind for growth stocks and a headwind for CBA and the banks who benefit from higher rates. Relevant for your GOOGL, MSFT, and CBA positions.

stories.title: Temporary fall in inflation won't ease RBA fears
stories.why_it_matters: Even with hike bets unwinding, the RBA may not be done. Any surprise rate move would hit bond-sensitive stocks and the banks.

ai.summary: The AI news cycle today is dominated by a single big theme: Pope Leo XIV's encyclical calling for robust regulation of AI, particularly around warfare and worker dignity. It's a significant cultural moment that will feed regulatory debate globally. Separately, Google dropped Gemini Omni — that's the actual product news worth watching, especially given GOOGL is in your portfolio.

stories.title: Introducing Gemini Omni
stories.why_it_matters: Google's latest flagship model launch. Directly relevant to Alphabet's AI competitive position and your GOOGL holding. Worth checking what capabilities it's claiming over GPT-4o and Claude.

stories.title: Pope Leo Calls For AI Regulation And Protecting The Dignity Of Workers In First Encyclical
stories.why_it_matters: A papal encyclical on AI is a cultural milestone that will amplify calls for regulation in Europe and beyond. Could accelerate legislative pressure on Big Tech — including Alphabet and Microsoft.

stories.title: Pope Leo Warns of AI Risks, Calls for Oversight in Finance & War
stories.why_it_matters: The finance and warfare angle is the sharpest part of this story. Autonomous weapons and algorithmic finance are the two domains where regulatory crackdowns could move fastest.

sport.summary: AFL is grieving the passing of Neale Daniher — a genuine legend and Fight MND icon — at age 65. That's the main story. NRL Round 13 previews are doing the rounds with Origin selection uncertainty clouding team lists. A World Surf League event in New Zealand was halted after an Australian photographer was bitten by what's believed to be a shark or sea lion.

stories.title: Neale Daniher, football legend and Fight MND campaigner, dies aged 65
stories.why_it_matters: Daniher is one of the most beloved figures in Australian football, and his Fight MND campaign changed how the country thinks about the disease. A significant moment for the footy community.

stories.title: NRL round 13 predicted teams: Mystery surrounds Origin stars; Tigers, Warriors cop major injury blows
stories.why_it_matters: Origin selection uncertainty is scrambling Round 13 team lists. Tigers and Warriors are already thin — injury blows make it worse for fantasy and tips.

stories.title: World Surf League event in NZ put on hold after Australian photographer bitten by 'shark or a sea lion'
stories.why_it_matters: WSL event suspended — unusual story with an Aussie connection. The ambiguity over whether it was a shark or sea lion is doing the internet a favour.

watch_today.title: Labor's CGT + negative gearing reform package
watch_today.detail: If this gets confirmed as formal policy, it's a material change for property investors and potentially shifts capital toward equities. Watch for any further AFR reporting or government statements today.

watch_today.title: Gemini Omni launch — Alphabet response
watch_today.detail: Google dropped a new flagship model today. With GOOGL already down 1.2%, any positive market reaction to the Gemini Omni announcement could provide a bounce. Worth monitoring US market open.
